title: An Unfinished Monolith Column in Mahneh Yehudah Quarter, Jerusalem
author: S. A. S. Husseini
location_note: Mahane Yehuda quarter, Jerusalem (building foundations, Nov. 1934); no map reference; placed by name.
notes: Monolith column shaft (9 m long, 1.25 m diameter) still lying in its quarry bed, abandoned because of splits. The author compares its length with Josephus' pillars of the Royal Cloisters of Herod's Temple and suggests it was 'possibly' meant for them (hedged dating, followed under amendment A4).

features.subtype: quarry bed with unfinished monolith column shaft, rock cut away in a V on both sides
features.period: possibly Herodian (author: perhaps meant for the cloisters of Herod's Temple)
features.quote: which still lies on the bed of the quarry
